errors.evidence: The figure image does not have a title. The description fabricates a title using the figure caption, which was provided as separate metadata.

errors.text_span: in the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse”
errors.evidence: The description includes the name of the paper where the figure appeared. This information is external context and is not present in the figure image itself.
The description uses the word "approximately" when describing the percentages, but the chart displays the exact values (e.g., 46.0%, 33.0%). This makes the description unnecessarily imprecise.

errors.text_span: wobei die Segmente im Kreis in der Reihenfolge 2019, 2017 und 2018 angeordnet erscheinen
errors.evidence: The description states the order of the segments is 2019, 2017, and 2018. However, the actual clockwise order of the segments, starting from the top, is 2019 (blue), 2018 (orange), and 2017 (green).
